name: Markolines Pavement Technologies Ltd
title: Markolines Pavement Technologies Ltd - 543364 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Highway O&M contractor with no capacity signal: FY26 revenue Rs 348.49 cr, PAT Rs 26.23 cr, capex only ~Rs 10 cr planned, and a 30% FY27 growth target without a numeric margin guide.

capex.quote: we are definitely looking at introducing one more or few pavers and maybe one HMP close to about 10 crore of CAPEX this year.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth at least 30%
triggers.quote: we are expecting a very good growth this year to the tune of at least 30%.

triggers.label: Order book ~Rs 600 cr; pipeline Rs 2,000 cr
triggers.quote: As of 31st March, we had an unexecuted order book of 600 crores plus

triggers.label: Merger timing shifted, no numeric margin guide
triggers.quote: we are expecting over by the year end. if you look at NCLT and all other processes, generally it will take six months.

guidance.quote: we are expecting a very good growth this year to the tune of at least 30%.
We are expecting that we should have an at least 1000 crore order book.
close to about 10 crore of CAPEX this year.

red_flags.quote: EBITDAs are subjective, because of the client 's need.

red_flags.quote: we recently announced and already completed the filing with the exchange for the merger of Markolines Pavement and Markolines Infra.
